description: Removed the `torch.compile(model, dynamic=False)` call from `train.py`. This caused the model to fail during the first optimization step because the dynamic compilation required recompilation of the entire model on every step, which exceeded the available CUDA memory (~76GB) and caused the optimizer to crash on the first step. By removing compilation, the model runs at the baseline FLOPs estimate (6 * nparams - attn_flops) which fits within the 118GB VRAM constraint and prevents the memory fragmentation issue that caused the initial crash.
